<script setup lang="ts" generic="T">
const foo = () => {};

defineExpose({ foo });
</script>

<template>
  <div />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from "vue";

const child = useTemplateRef("child");
child.value?.foo();
</script>

<template>
  <Child ref="child" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts" generic="T">
const foo = () => {};

defineExpose({ foo });
</script>

<template>
  <div />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from "vue";

const child = useTemplateRef("child");
child.value?.nope();
</script>

<template>
  <Child ref="child" />
</template>

expectedTsrs.stdout: src/Probe.vue(5,14): error TS2339: Property 'nope' does not exist on type '{ foo: () => void; }'.
